verdict_reason: It is a world-generation framework (brief section 4 test 5: dissonant; section 2: no worldgen), yet it is wired into how the campaign's SOURCE world was made. Our src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/JawaWorld_BiomeMix.xml patches the TidallyLocked PlanetTypeDef of `7f.alienworlds.tidallylocked` (its header: kept because it configures the game that produces the source world Ash'karr is painted from), UtinniPatches About.xml forceLoadAfter names both mods (lines 81-82), and tidally_locked_world.md records the mod as worldgen-only (FieldPatcher hooks WorldGenStep_Terrain; nothing recomputes temperature at runtime, so it cannot reach the hand-painted frozen save). Runtime need is therefore nil but the authoring/remake path may still use it, and removing it unguarded breaks UtinniPatches' patch target. Held until the final paint/remake settles whether the source world is ever regenerated (brief section 5.8).
